name: Playback Analytics
description: Adds an administrator dashboard for all playable media, including never-watched items. Includes storage, viewing time, sessions, viewers, series-level episode aggregation, filtering, sorting, and CSV export.
overview: Library-wide playback and storage analytics powered by Jellyfin and Playback Reporting.

versions.changelog: Release 1.0.0.0. See the GitHub release notes for details.
